text: Entry2124 centralizes the fake IMAP INBOX hierarchyDelimiter="/" assignment in createAccount and replaces direct subfolder creation with awaited createSubfolder in both MV2 and MV3 tests. The helper registers folder-added before creation, then reads the child. Keep that setup and completion contract when using this fixture. The underlying notification helper filters by name only; the sequential assertions do not prove concurrent equal-name isolation. Fixed createAccount is now async for later protocol support, while delimiter setup remains. This is a test-fixture contract, not a universal server delimiter rule. No xpcshell test ran.
title: Extension xpcshell account setup owns the fake IMAP delimiter
